overview: A 45-day fitness and wellness transformation app for Indian users with guided workouts, an Indian-food diet plan, progress tracking, and a subscription paywall.
features: Sign in with Internet Identity and complete a short onboarding flow
Follow a data-driven 45-day program with daily workout unlock system
Run animated workout sessions with timers and progress tracking
Track calories with an Indian-food diet plan
Monitor progress with completion history and streaks
Unlock the full program with a 90-day subscription
